description: Starts the Electron project on free debugging ports, so both the renderer (CDP) and the main process (Node inspector) are reachable, and waits for the first window. It runs `electron .` with the project's own Electron, or the launch command configured with --launch-cmd (e.g. a dev server).

project.description: Project folder (default: the folder the viewer or MCP was started in)

name: launch_app
title: Launch app
